description:
### Kizu 2.0.1-beta.27

- Adds a bundled native Twitch emote catalog to the horizontal strip and merges local account emotes.
- Combines Twitch-native emotes with 7TV/BTTV/FFZ in one strip, suppressing the competing vertical emote popup while preserving mention and slash-command autocomplete.
- Shows native global emotes immediately, merges account-recent native emotes from Twitch's local database, and refreshes after each third-party provider or image loads.
- Reduces provider retry backoff from five minutes to 20 seconds, increases catalog workers from four to six, shortens HTTP timeouts, and logs request latency/status/response size. Test-only prerelease; stable v2.0.0 is unchanged.
